about: Expense reimbursement for staff (StaffExpenses.swift): money the company pays back for what a job needs, booked as an expense, not as wages. Every figure is a game design value, not from a source. `monthlyCost` is per person a month at the reference price level (scaled in code). `roles` are the jobs it applies to ("*" = every job). `learnBoost` is the share by which an ongoing training budget speeds up learning on the job (the existing skill growth of StaffRoutine.growSkills); the other items have no modelled effect, they are a cost the player chooses. Tax: a country can list an item under `staffExpenses` in its data with {"employerCharge": true} when the reimbursement is a taxable benefit that carries the employer's social charge; with no entry the treatment is neutral (no extra charge). No country entry exists yet (see docs/TAX_SOURCES.md).

items.name: Phone allowance
items.detail: The company pays the work phone bill.

items.name: Uniform and work clothes
items.detail: The company pays for uniforms, work clothes and their cleaning.

items.name: Training allowance
items.detail: A yearly learning budget used month by month: they learn on the job faster.

items.name: Travel expenses
items.detail: Fares, fuel and parking for work trips, repaid against receipts.
